instruction: Set Arial as the default font for LibreOffice Writer documents

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font in LibreOffice Writer to Arial. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file to verify the default font setting has been changed to 'Arial'. This uses the existing find_default_font metric function which parses the XML configuration file.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary scoring: 1.0 if default font is set to Arial, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the LibreOffice configuration file at /home/user/.config/libreoffice/4/user/registrymodifications.xcu where default font settings are stored
Metric function find_default_font properly parses the XML structure looking for /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont with property Standard
Expected value 'Arial' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Binary scoring (1.0 or 0.0) is appropriate for this verification task
Evaluator includes proper error handling for missing files and XML parsing errors
No postconfig needed as the configuration file persists after settings dialog is closed
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires (default font = Arial)
